instruction: Find Disney Princess toys for girls and sort by price from low to high.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Disney Princess toys for girls on kohls.com and sorting by price low-high. Similar complexity to original with different product theme. Evaluator uses check_direct_json_object to verify search and sort.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 4 instruction requirements: Disney Princess search term, Toys category, Girls category, and Price Low-High sorting
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts breadcrumb elements and URL parameters, metric compares against expected boolean values
Dual verification strategy (HTML parsing + URL checking) provides good redundancy if one method fails
Expected values are semantically correct: all search/filter terms set to true, is_other_exist set to false to ensure no unintended filters
The is_other_exist check correctly verifies that no additional unexpected filters are applied
Minor robustness concern: evaluator relies on Kohl's-specific CSS classes (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector, catAllProducts) which may break if HTML structure changes
However, URL parameter checking (S=4 for sort, search terms in URL) provides fallback verification method
